headword: {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}
gloss: below-floor flooding; flooding that does not rise above the floor level

definitions.gloss: below-floor flooding; flooding where water enters the space under the floor but does not rise above floor level
definitions.explanation: A category of flood damage, defined in Japanese disaster statistics, in which floodwater has entered the crawl space or ground beneath a building but has not risen above the floor. Less severe than {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい} (above-floor flooding), but still a significant form of damage.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}が{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: There was a lot of below-floor flooding in this area.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{近所|きんじょ}の{家|いえ}が{床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}の{被害|ひがい}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: The neighbor's house suffered below-floor flood damage from the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}でも、{放|ほう}っておくと{湿気|しっけ}やカビの{原因|げんいん}になる。
examples.english: Even below-floor flooding can lead to dampness and mold if left untreated.

examples.japanese: {市内|しない}で{床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}が{報告|ほうこく}された{住宅|じゅうたく}は{百軒|ひゃっけん}を{超|こ}えるという。
examples.english: More than one hundred homes in the city were reported to have suffered below-floor flooding.

notes:
Composed of {床下|ゆかした} (under the floor) and {浸水|しんすい} (flooding, water damage). A set phrase used in official disaster reports and news coverage.

USAGE:
In Japanese disaster statistics, flooding damage to houses is officially classified into {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい} (above-floor flooding) and {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい} (below-floor flooding). You will see these two categories in municipal damage reports, weather news, and insurance documents. {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい} is the less severe category: water has entered under the house but the living space above is still dry.

Even though floors remain dry, {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい} should not be ignored. Residents typically need to drain, clean, and disinfect the crawl space to prevent mold, rot, and pest problems later.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}の{被害|ひがい}: below-floor flood damage
- {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}が{発生|はっせい}する: below-floor flooding occurs
- {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}{○{○軒|けん}}: N homes affected by below-floor flooding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}: above-floor flooding — the more severe category, where water rises above the floor
- {浸水|しんすい}: flooding; water intrusion — the general term
- {冠水|かんすう}: submergence (of roads, fields) — flooding of an area rather than a specific building
- {水害|すいがい}: flood disaster; water damage — the broadest term for damage caused by water
